thought.text: The frontend renders the Qonnectra login page. Now let me address the tileserver issue (missing mbtiles, documented as user-generated). Let me check whether it blocks the stack.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployment && docker logs qonnectra_tileserver_dev 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "=== caddy tiles ==="; CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev); docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://tiles.localhost/

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/deployment && docker logs qonnectra_tileserver_dev 2>&1 | tail -8; echo \"=== caddy tiles ===\"; CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev); docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" https://tiles.localhost/", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check tileserver status"}
